brief.ask: Art-direct "Blue Ridge Morning Mist" — #5 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Scenic Nature). Premise: Seven layered alpine ridges, summit sunbeams, and drifting valley cloud sea. Seven layered mountain ridges fade into atmospheric blue-gold perspective with alpine sunbeams and drifting valley fog. Lighting today: Key: Early alpine sunrise at 5000K over blue-slate ridges. Service use: Creation hymns, Psalms of ascent, faithfulness & majesty songs. Audio mapping today: Harmonic → Illuminates valley mist ribbons between mountain ridges; Swell → Raises golden dawn sunbeams behind the highest summit; Vocal → Softly shimmers high-altitude cloud wisps. Palette: #0E1726 #28415C #7C98B3 #F5D39E. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the procedural scene (no concept plate: the plate is generative, in code) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: No concept plate: the scene is built entirely in code from the premise.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: Seven Ridges, One Measure
proposals.idea: A cantus firmus of seven procedurally-rendered depth planes — each ridge a voice in a fixed harmonic stack — governs every luminance, motion interval, and lyric placement so that the scene reads as a single resolved composition, not an animated wallpaper.
proposals.geometry: Seven ridge silhouettes are constructed as cubic Bézier curves on a 12-column, 7-row harmonic grid whose row-heights follow a 1 : 0.809 golden diminution from foreground to horizon — the same proportional diminution Palladio uses in the Villa Rotonda's section. Ridge 1 (foreground, #0E1726) sits at 78% canvas height; Ridge 7 (rearmost, near-white #F5D39E at 8% opacity) sits at 38%. The lyric band occupies rows 5–6 of the grid (42–58% canvas height), centred on the optical midpoint between the third and fourth ridge — a rest point earned by the recession of the planes above it. God-ray shafts originate from a single polar-coordinate light source declared as a code constant (azimuth 22° left of centre, elevation 14° above Ridge 7's apex) and are never renegotiated regardless of content. All bokeh motes and cloud-wisp particles seed only at luminance peaks inherited from the ridge stack — n
proposals.typography: Cinzel Regular, 3.2% of canvas height (≈34px at 1080p, ≈68px at 4K) for the active lyric line — set in sentence case, tracked at +120, measure locked to 60% canvas width so no line exceeds nine words at that scale. Word-by-word reveal: each incoming word fades from opacity 0 to 1 over 280 ms with a subtle 2px upward translate — never a pop, never a slide; the motion is the breath of a page turn. The completed line holds for the remainder of its 4–5 s interval; it does not animate again. The outgoing line dissolves at 400 ms. A secondary Noto Serif Italic line at 1.8% canvas height sits 1.5× the Cinzel cap-height below the active line — scripture reference or song title — tracked at +60, opacity 55%, acting as the continuo beneath the melody. No Inter or Mono in this direction; those voices are not needed here. All type sits inside the text-safe dimming band: a full-width horizontal bar o
proposals.imageLogic: There is no concept plate and no imported photography. The scene is entirely procedural: seven Bézier ridge curves are drawn in Canvas 2D with layered radial and linear gradients composited in 'lighter' and 'multiply' blend modes. Atmospheric haze between ridges is rendered as semi-transparent filled gradient rectangles whose opacity is a function of depth-index (Ridge n opacity = 0.12 + (n × 0.11)) — this is aerial perspective as a formula, not a texture import. God rays are drawn as fanned LinearGradient strokes (width tapered from 18px at source to 0px at canvas edge) originating from the declared polar-coordinate constant. Cloud wisps in the valley are sinusoidal ribbon paths redrawn each frame with a phase offset driven by elapsed time — slow enough (full period ≈ 28 s) that they read as breathing, not motion. The 2px structural counterpoint offset is applied to every geometric prim
proposals.texture: Simulated 35mm grain is a per-frame Canvas 2D noise pass: a 4px-cell value-noise field (seeded once, scrolled at 0.4 px/s diagonally) drawn at 6% opacity in 'overlay' blend mode over the composite — this is the film grain of the optical pass, never strobing, always present. Anamorphic flare is a horizontal LinearGradient bar at the god-ray source point: #F5D39E at 18% opacity, height 1px, width 40% canvas, blur-simulated by drawing three stacked bars at widths 40%, 20%, 8% and opacities 18%, 10%, 5% — the lens trace of a real sunrise through real glass, rendered in code. The material weave keyed to this lens is parchment-over-stone: the foreground ridge (#0E1726) carries the grain pass at double weight (12% opacity) to simulate the tooth of cold-press paper on dark ink; the rearmost ridge carries it at 2% so the horizon reads as atmosphere, not surface.
proposals.motion: The temporal hierarchy is stated as code constants before any content exists and is never renegotiated. Background ridge stack: present at scene load, no entrance animation — it is the cantus firmus, it does not arrive, it is already there. God-ray shafts: grow from source point to full length over 1.4 s on first load (opacity 0→0.72), then breathe at ±8% amplitude on a 6 s sinusoidal cycle. Valley mist ribbons: enter at 0.6 s after load, drift laterally at 0.3 px/s, oscillate vertically ±4px on a 22 s cycle. Bokeh motes (maximum 18, seeded at ridge-luminance peaks): fade in depth-order, 120 ms apart, over 2.2 s total. Audio mapping — Harmonic band (80–800 Hz) drives valley mist ribbon opacity (resting 0.18, peak 0.42, smoothed with 180 ms attack / 600 ms release); Swell band (sub-bass energy envelope) raises god-ray shaft opacity (resting 0.52, peak 0.82, spring-damped k=0.12 so no stro
proposals.productionMethod: Pure Canvas 2D renderer in Plajah's existing worship kit. All geometry is procedural JavaScript: Bézier path construction, LinearGradient and RadialGradient fills, blend-mode compositing, per-frame noise pass. The polar-coordinate light source, the 12×7 harmonic grid constants, the seven ridge height percentages, the god-ray azimuth/elevation, the temporal constants (0.6 s, 120 ms, 1.4 s, 2.2 s), and the audio envelope parameters (attack, release, spring k) are all declared as a single exported constants object at the top of the module — the cantus firmus in code — and imported by every other module. The 2px structural offset is a single constant applied at draw time to even-indexed layer origins. No WebGL, no video, no imported images, no external assets. Runs at 60 fps on integrated GPU because every draw call is a gradient fill or a stroked path, not a particle system — the bokeh cap
proposals.humanTrace: Editorial selection of the seven ridge Bézier control points — these are not algorithmically generated curves; they are authored control-point coordinates chosen to read as a specific mountain range (broad asymmetric shoulders, one dominant summit left of centre at 38% canvas width) rather than a generic silhouette. The polar-coordinate light source azimuth (22° left of centre) is not symmetric and not random — it is a directorial decision made before the code was written, the way a cinematographer chooses a key light before the actor enters. The parchment grain weight differential between foreground and rearmost ridge (12% vs 2%) is a material judgment, not a formula output. These are the signs of making that survive the generative method.
proposals.risk: The scene is resolved before the first lyric appears — seven ridges, one light source, one measure — and it does not change its fundamental structure in response to the music. The risk is that a congregation or a worship leader trained on reactive visualizers reads this stillness as technical failure rather than compositional intention. That risk is worth carrying because the brief demands a sanctuary that breathes, not a visualizer that performs; and because a scene whose structure is audible in every frame — because every frame is the same resolved composition, only differently illuminated — will still read correctly at the back pew in ten years, on whatever projector replaces this one.

proposals.title: Ink Bleed Into Mountain Air
proposals.idea: Seven ridges are not painted — they are pulled: each depth plane is a generative ink-wash drawdown, its edge ragged by a per-layer Perlin displacement seeded once at load and never smoothed away, so the mountain is always mid-gesture, never resolved.
proposals.geometry: Seven horizontal depth planes stacked in logarithmic recession: plane 1 (darkest, nearest) occupies the bottom 38% of canvas height; each successive plane steps back by a ratio of 0.72 — not even, not tidy, calibrated to the way actual ridge silhouettes compress in atmosphere. The sunbeam source is fixed at polar azimuth 22° from frame-left, elevation 14° above the highest ridge crest, declared as a constant before any draw call — every god-ray, every bokeh origin, every specular ribbon answers to that one prior decision. The lyric band sits in the lower 22% of frame, its baseline anchored at 18% from bottom: it never moves vertically. The text-safe dimming band is a 14%-canvas-height gradient trapezoid, wider at base, whose opacity is a fixed 0.72 — the scene dims into it, the words do not float above it.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif at 6.2vw, lowercase except proper nouns, tracking –0.01em — tight enough that the line reads as a breath, not a billboard. Word-by-word reveal: each incoming word fades from 0 to 1 opacity over 18 frames; outgoing line dissolves in 24 frames as a whole phrase, never word-by-word on exit (the line earns its leave together). No all-caps. No display weight. Weight stays at 400 — the mountain is already doing the drama. Line measure: never wider than 72% of canvas width, centered. A hair-thin 1px rule in #7C98B3 at 40% opacity sits 12px above the lyric baseline — not decorative, it is the registration edge that tells the eye 'words live below here, sky lives above.'
proposals.imageLogic: No photograph, no scan, no plate. Every ridge silhouette is drawn at runtime: a per-plane baseline walks left to right, displaced vertically by two stacked Perlin octaves (frequencies 0.004 and 0.011, amplitudes 48px and 19px, seeded from plane index × 137 — prime, so no two planes share a harmonic). The displacement is computed once on load, written to an offscreen canvas, and cached — the ridge shape is fixed for the session, the way a block is cut once and pulled many times. Valley mist is a second generative pass: horizontal gradient strips between planes, their vertical extent driven by the harmonic amplitude envelope (smoothed with a 120ms exponential decay). Sunbeams are six radial lines from the fixed polar source, widths between 18px and 52px, drawn with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' at 4–9% opacity — they exist as luminance evidence, not decoration.
proposals.texture: The kit's material weave for this lens is simulated relief-print tooth: a fullscreen noise layer (256×256 tiled, generated once via a value-noise shader baked to an offscreen canvas) composited at 'multiply' with 8% opacity over the scene before the optical pass. This is the only texture pass. It makes the gradient planes read as paper pulling ink rather than pixel gradients. Film grain in the optical pass runs at amplitude 0.06 — present, not featured. No bokeh particles beyond the kit's mote layer (max 12 motes, large, slow, 0.3–2.2s drift cycles). The foil shimmer from the kit's optical pass is locked to the same 22° azimuth as the sunbeam source: the highlight vector is not a mood choice, it is the same prior commitment.
proposals.motion: Everything moves at the speed of held breath. Ridge planes: stationary — they were cut once, they stay. Valley mist ribbons (between planes 2–5): vertical extent oscillates ±22px driven by harmonic amplitude, smoothed 120ms decay, never faster than 0.4Hz apparent frequency. Sunbeam god-rays: opacity pulses between 0.04 and 0.09 driven by swell amplitude, spring-damped k=0.12 — they brighten when the arrangement swells, they never strobe. High-altitude cloud wisps (above plane 7): a slow horizontal drift at 0.3px/frame for three wisp shapes, their luminance shimmer driven by vocal amplitude, smoothed 80ms — when the voice is present the wisps catch the light; when it drops they go still. The optical pass light-leak flickers at 0.3–1.8Hz Perlin-driven, non-looping, amplitude ≤0.07 — material witness, not effect. Nothing on this canvas accelerates. proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer. All geometry drawn each frame from cached offscreen canvases (ridge silhouettes, noise texture, mist strips — generated once at load, repainted only when audio drives opacity/extent changes). Sunbeams drawn directly each frame as radial fills (cheap). The kit's optical pass composited as a final fullscreen layer. Audio envelopes: WebAudio AnalyserNode, three bands — harmonic (80–400Hz), swell (400–2kHz RMS), vocal (2–8kHz presence). All envelopes exponential-smoothed. No particles beyond the kit's 12-mote pool. Target: under 4ms paint time per frame on integrated GPU.
proposals.humanTrace: The ridge displacement is seeded from a prime-stepped index — no two sessions produce the same silhouette, but every silhouette within a session is fixed, the way a pulled print is fixed once the ink is down. The noise texture is generated once; its particular grain is this session's grain. The operator who sets the polar light source (22° azimuth, 14° elevation) before the service makes a prior physical commitment — everything rendered that morning answers to it. That decision is the human mark. The congregant at forty metres reads mountain ridges that have a specific, unrepeatable edge: not procedural smoothness, not a photograph, but generative evidence of a rule applied under constraint.
proposals.risk: The ragged Perlin-displaced ridge edge is the risk. Every other direction in this room will give the congregation something resolved — a clean silhouette, a perfect gradient, a luminous finish. This one leaves the edge of the mountain mid-gesture, never fully landed. In a worship context that could read as unfinished, careless, or — the real risk — like a technical error. The bet is that at five to forty metres, from pew depth, the congregation does not read 'glitch,' they read 'breath' — the way a charcoal line reads breath at distance even though it is ragged up close. If it reads as broken, it fails the sanctuary. That risk is worth carrying because the alternative — the resolved, polished, screensaver mountain — is exactly what this brief says it must not become.

proposals.title: State Machine of Atmospheric Depth
proposals.idea: Seven ridge planes are a coordinate system, not a painting — each plane holds a fixed luminance value, parallax gain ratio, and audio-response contract, so every visual event is a derivable output of the same generative axiom rather than an aesthetic decoration.
proposals.geometry: Seven horizontal depth planes subdivide the canvas on a non-linear z-curve: plane 1 (foreground ridge, y=72–100%) at luminance L=0.08, plane 7 (summit, y=12–28%) at L=0.72; the spacing between planes compresses logarithmically toward the horizon following aerial-perspective physics, so the perceived distance between planes 6 and 7 is roughly twice the pixel distance between planes 1 and 2. Each plane is a closed polygon path, cached as an offscreen canvas at initialisation. A single light-source axiom — azimuth 35°, elevation 22° — governs every downstream parameter: god-ray origin point is computed as canvas intersection of that vector from summit centroid; parallax gain per plane is cos(plane_index × 8°) scaled 0–3px; shadow offset is the same vector at 0.4 opacity. The valley floor (plane 0, y=78–100%) holds the mist layer. No decorative geometry is added outside this coordinate autho
proposals.typography: Cinzel Regular, uppercase, tracked at 0.18em — the geometry of the letterform reads as cut stone at projection distance, never as font cosplay. Single lyric line centred horizontally; vertical anchor at y=82% of canvas (lower third, inside the text-safe band). Cap-height scales to 4.2vh at 1080p (≈45px), 4.2vh at 4K — optical size maintained by vh unit, not px. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 180ms (ease-out cubic), previous words hold at full opacity; line transition is a 320ms cross-dissolve with a simultaneous 0.6px upward translate on the incoming line — perceptible as breath, not as a slide. Text-safe band: a gradient rect from y=72% to y=100%, #0E1726 at 0–38% opacity ramping with harmonic amplitude (floor 28%, ceiling 52%), so the band breathes with the music without ever dropping below legibility threshold. No italic, no bold, no mixed case — Cinzel's own weight hier
proposals.imageLogic: No photographic plate. The scene is a pure procedural state machine. Each of the seven ridge polygons is drawn with a radial-gradient fill whose centre tracks the 35°/22° light axiom: the gradient origin is the computed god-ray anchor, inner colour is a mix of #7C98B3 and #F5D39E weighted by plane luminance L, outer colour is #0E1726. Mist ribbons between planes are horizontal sine-wave strips (amplitude 6–14px, frequency 0.003–0.007 cycles/px, phase offset per plane) drawn as filled paths with globalAlpha 0.12–0.28, animated by a slow phase increment (0.0004 rad/frame) — no particle system, no texture lookup. God rays are 6 radial line segments from the light-source anchor, each 1.5px wide, drawn with a linear gradient from rgba(245,211,158,0.18) to transparent, length scaled to 55% of canvas height. proposals.texture: Material weave is the kit's computation-and-light pass, not a scanned surface. Film grain: a 256×256 noise tile (generated once at init via ImageData, Perlin-ish via value noise) composited at globalAlpha 0.04 with 'overlay' blend — this is the human trace of capture, not nostalgia. Anamorphic flare: a single horizontal streak from the god-ray anchor, drawn as a 1px-tall gradient rect 80% canvas-width, opacity 0.07, colour #F5D39E — fires only when swell amplitude > 0.6, rises in 400ms, decays in 900ms (matching kit timing contract). Light leak: a soft radial gradient in the upper-right quadrant, #F5D39E at 0.06 opacity, persistent, scaled by swell envelope. proposals.motion: Three independent envelopes drive the scene; all are spring-damped (stiffness 0.08, damping 0.72) to prevent strobing. Harmonic envelope → mist-ribbon globalAlpha (range 0.08–0.34) and mist phase-increment multiplier (range 0.8–1.6×); when harmonic rises, the valley breathes visibly. Swell envelope → god-ray length scalar (range 0.4–0.7 of canvas height) and god-ray opacity (range 0.10–0.22); a swell peak reads as the sun cresting the ridge. Vocal envelope → bokeh-mote opacity scalar (range 0.6–1.4×) and high-altitude cloud-wisp alpha (plane 6–7 mist strips, range 0.06–0.18); a vocal phrase shimmers the summit atmosphere. Parallax: a slow autonomous drift — each plane's x-offset oscillates on a cosine with period 28–44 seconds (period proportional to plane depth), amplitude 0–2.4px. proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer. Init pass (runs once, ~80ms): generate seven ridge polygon path arrays from parametric formula; generate 256×256 grain tile via value-noise ImageData; compute LUT for colour-punch curves; seed bokeh LCG table (24 entries); compute god-ray anchor from 35°/22° axiom and canvas dimensions; build all offscreen canvases. Per-frame pass (target 60fps, integrated GPU): clear main canvas; draw ridges from back to front (7→1) onto ridge offscreen; draw mist strips onto mist offscreen; draw god rays + flare onto ray offscreen; draw bokeh onto bokeh offscreen (bokeh canvas uses ctx.filter blur, set once); composite all offscreen layers onto main canvas in z-order; apply grain tile at overlay blend; run colour-punch LUT on 480×270 proxy, scale result up and composite; draw text-safe band; render lyric engine output. Audio read: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, FFT 1024, three band-pas
proposals.humanTrace: The perceptible sign of making is editorial selection inside a deterministic system: the seven ridge polygons are shaped by a parametric silhouette function whose three control parameters (peak frequency, amplitude variance, base slope) were chosen by a human looking at Blue Ridge aerial reference and deciding which abstraction reads as mountain without illustrating one. The grain tile and the colour-punch LUT are computed, but the curve anchor points were set by eye against the four palette colours at 1080p on a calibrated display. The anamorphic flare timing (400ms rise, 900ms decay) was measured against a breath cycle, not derived from a formula. These are craft decisions made inside a generative system — the human trace is in the parameters, not the pixels.
proposals.risk: The risk is affective flatness: a system this logically constrained can produce a scene that is correct and cold — a diagram of a mountain, not a sanctuary. The ridge polygons are abstract enough that a congregation member who has never seen Blue Ridge will not read 'mountain' from five metres in the first three seconds. The counter-argument is that the atmospheric depth gradient and the mist motion do the recognition work faster than silhouette detail, and that the stillness of the system — no particle storm, no camera shake, no dissolve cascade — is precisely what makes it feel like a place to rest rather than a show to watch. The risk is worth taking because the alternative (more illustrative detail) either exceeds the GPU budget or requires a texture asset the build method prohibits.

proposals.title: Seven Ridges, One Light
proposals.idea: Each of the seven depth planes is a discrete atmospheric stratum — independently breathable, topographically plausible, rooted in the specific visual grammar of Blue Ridge dawn photography from the Appalachian highland corridor — so that the congregation reads a real place, not a mood.
proposals.geometry: Seven parallelogram-silhouette ridge bands stacked on a 14-row vertical grid (each row ≈ 77px at 1080p), indexed 1 (foreground, darkest, #0E1726) through 7 (summit, near-white gold). Ridge crests are procedurally generated cubic-Bézier curves seeded from a fixed noise table — same curve every render, never random-walk drift — so the horizon feels geologically settled. The valley floor occupies rows 8–14 and is the primary mist field. A fixed horizon sits at 38% from top (golden-ratio complement of the text band below). The lyric band occupies a 240px-tall safe zone pinned to the bottom 22% of the canvas; above it, a 40px feathered dimming gradient at 0.72 opacity anchors the scene without cutting it.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif for all lyric lines — Regular weight, sentence case, 52px at 1080p (scales to 104px at 4K). Tracking: +0.04em. Measure: 68 characters max, centred. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 180ms with a +6px upward translate that eases to rest (spring k=0.18, damping=0.82), so the line assembles the way breath assembles a phrase. The completed line holds for the remainder of its 4–5 second slot; on exit, the full line dissolves in 320ms. No bold, no italic, no Cinzel here — Cinzel is reserved for the scripture reference line (14px, all-caps, +0.18em tracking) that appears below the lyric in a secondary tier, 28px smaller, same centre axis. White at 0.94 opacity over the dimming band; drop-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(14,23,38,0.82) to carry legibility over the brightest god-ray moment.

Each ridge silhouette is drawn as a filled path: cubic Bézier control points are pre-computed once from a seeded Perlin-noise table (seed 5724, 'Blue Ridge Morning Mist') and cached as a Float32Array; they do not re-compute at runtime. Ridge colours are linear interpolates between #0E1726 (ridge 1) and a warm #C4A97D (ridge 7 crest) with atmospheric haze applied as a per-ridge globalAlpha step (0.96 → 0.42 front to back). proposals.texture: The material weave for this lens is documentary field-notebook paper: a pre-rendered 512×512 tileable noise texture (generated once via a GLSL-to-Canvas offline bake, stored as a PNG data URI in the kit) applied at 0.07 opacity in 'soft-light' composite mode over the entire canvas, giving every gradient a slight tooth — the sensation of looking at a watercolour wash on cold-press paper rather than a screen gradient. This is the World-Eclectic lens's specific material: not gold leaf (that is the Dramatist's), not raw concrete (that is the Minimalist's), but the field notebook — the surface of someone who went to the ridge and wrote it down. The grain tile is offset by +1px per frame in alternating x/y on a 4-frame cycle to avoid static moire.
proposals.motion: All motion is slow, continuous, and spring-damped. Ridge planes: no lateral drift. The mist ribbons between ridges 2 and 4 translate horizontally at 0.18px/frame (≈10.8px/sec at 60fps), alternating direction per ribbon, wrapping seamlessly — this is the only lateral motion in the scene and it is nearly imperceptible at 10 metres. God rays: opacity breathes on the swell envelope, rise time 1.8s, fall time 3.2s, max delta-opacity 0.28 per breath cycle; their geometry is fixed (no rotation, no scan). Cloud wisps: sine-wave phase advances at 0.0004 rad/frame; the vocal envelope lifts their luminosity (globalAlpha 0.12 → 0.34). Film grain tile: advances one frame in the pre-rendered 64-frame loop every 2 canvas frames, giving a 32fps grain flutter that reads as analog without strobing. proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D real-time renderer. Initialisation: seed the Bézier noise table once (≈2ms), bake the 512×512 paper-grain PNG data URI into the kit bundle offline, cache all gradient objects as CanvasGradient references in an init() call so no gradient is constructed per frame. proposals.humanTrace: The seeded Bézier noise table (seed 5724) was chosen after reviewing USGS topographic profiles of the Blue Ridge Parkway between Milepost 0 (Afton Mountain, Virginia) and Milepost 217 (Blowing Rock, North Carolina) — the specific highland corridor this premise describes. The ridge crest shapes are not random; they are tuned to the characteristic long-wavelength undulation of Appalachian ridgelines, which differ measurably from Rocky Mountain or Alpine profiles. That editorial decision — which noise frequencies to weight, which to suppress — is the field-notebook trace: the director went to the place in data, named it, and let it constrain the procedural output. The paper-grain texture baked offline carries the tooth of cold-press watercolour paper, the surface on which highland documentary field sketches are conventionally made. The 35° azimuth is the Collection I declared light origin,
proposals.risk: The risk is that seven discrete ridge planes drawn as flat filled paths look diagrammatic — a geology textbook, not a sanctuary. The counter is that the atmospheric haze gradient (globalAlpha stepping 0.96 → 0.42) and the paper-grain soft-light pass together push the flat fills past diagram into wash, and that the mist ribbons between ridges 2–4 provide the only volumetric illusion the scene needs. The deeper risk I am willing to name: I am drawing from a specific geographic and cultural landscape — the Blue Ridge, the Appalachian highland tradition, the specific visual vocabulary of highland morning fog as documented by photographers like Carr Clifton and Willard Clay — without those photographers in the room. The procedural abstraction is sufficient distance; no image is sampled or reproduced. But I am flagging the provenance so the team knows whose visual grammar we are working inside

proposals.title: Seven Ridges, One Dawn
proposals.idea: A procedural operatic diorama of seven depth planes, each a ridge of blue-slate atmosphere, through which a single declared light source — early alpine sunrise at 5000K — conducts every shimmer, god ray, mist ribbon, and typographic glow, so that the lyric band does not sit on top of the scene but is revealed by the same light that reveals the summit.
proposals.geometry: Seven horizontal depth planes stacked in strict atmospheric perspective: plane 1 (foreground) at 88% canvas height, each successive ridge rising by a factor of the golden ratio compressed — intervals of approximately 72px, 58px, 47px, 38px, 31px, 25px at 1080p — so the ridges crowd together toward the summit the way they do in actual alpine haze. The valley floor between ridges 1 and 2 is the widest breath; the sky above ridge 7 is the widest open field. The light source is declared once at canvas coordinates (62%, 8%) — upper-right, raking — and every shimmer vector, every god-ray origin, every bokeh drift, and every mist ribbon highlight derives its angle from that single point. No second light exists. The lyric band occupies a fixed horizontal zone from 68% to 82% canvas height, sitting in the valley between ridges 2 and 3, where the mist is thickest and the dimming band is most theat
proposals.typography: Cinzel, display weight, all-caps, for the lyric line — scale 52px at 1080p, tracked at 0.18em, centred, no line break within a line. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 18 frames (0.3s) with a simultaneous upward drift of 4px from its resting position, settling with a spring-damped ease — the motion is a breath, not a bounce. The active word carries a text-shadow keyed to the declared light-source angle: offset at 35° (matching the foil shimmer angle of the kit's optical pass), radius 12px, colour #F5D39E at 40% opacity — it reads as caught light, not glow. Completed words remain at full opacity until the line clears. Scripture reference or song title: Outfit Regular, 16px, tracked 0.28em, all-caps, positioned 18px below the lyric baseline, #7C98B3 at 65% opacity. The dimming band beneath the lyric zone is a radial gradient from #0E1726 at 72% opacity at centre to 0% at the band
proposals.imageLogic: There is no concept plate. The entire scene is procedural Canvas 2D. Seven ridge silhouettes are drawn as layered bezier fills: each ridge is a low-frequency noise curve (Perlin or simplex, seed fixed per ridge, spatial frequency 0.003 to 0.0008 descending toward the horizon) filled with a gradient that interpolates the palette by depth — foreground ridge fills from #28415C to #0E1726, mid ridges through #7C98B3, the farthest ridge nearly dissolving into #F5D39E-tinted sky haze. The valley fog between ridges 1–4 is rendered as horizontal ribbon gradients, semi-transparent, animated with a slow horizontal sine drift (period 18–28 seconds, amplitude 6–14px depending on depth plane) — these are the Harmonic-reactive elements. God rays are drawn as radial line-fills from the declared light-source point, masked by the ridge silhouettes, their opacity driven by Swell amplitude. The sky above r
proposals.texture: The kit's optical pass carries the material weave. For this direction the lead texture is simulated atmospheric haze: a full-canvas noise layer (simplex, z-scrolling at 0.0004 per frame) drawn at 6% opacity in screen blend mode, tinted #7C98B3 — it gives the air the granular quality of film grain shot at altitude, the slight halation you see in a 35mm frame of a mountain at dawn. The 35mm light-leak from the kit's optical pass enters from the upper-right corner (consistent with the declared light source) as a warm #F5D39E radial bloom, opacity 18–28%, pulsing gently with Swell. The anamorphic flare — a horizontal streak through the light-source point — fires only when Swell crosses 0.72 amplitude, fades over 90 frames, and never repeats within 8 seconds: it is an event, not a pattern. Film grain is a cached 512×512 noise texture, scrolled at one pixel per frame in a random walk, composit
proposals.motion: Everything moves at the pace of weather, not animation. Order of motion by layer, slowest to fastest: (1) Ridge silhouettes: static in position, but their noise seeds advance at 0.00008 per frame — over five minutes a ridge breathes almost imperceptibly, as if seen from a moving train. (2) Valley mist ribbons: horizontal sine drift, 18–28 second periods, Harmonic-amplitude scales their opacity from 28% to 52% — when the harmonic layer swells, the valley fills with fog. (3) God rays: Swell-driven, opacity 0% to 38%, rise from the light-source point behind ridge 7, drawn as 7–11 radial fills with slight angular jitter (±2°, fixed per ray per session) — they do not strobe; they grow and recede like actual sunrise light moving through cloud. (4) High-altitude wisps: Vocal-driven, opacity 4% to 22%, drift upward 2px over 60 frames when Vocal rises, settle back over 90 — the slowest reactive e
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps target. Seven ridge layers drawn each frame as bezier fills with simplex noise evaluated at low spatial frequency — the computation is cheap because the noise is low-resolution and the curves have 8–12 control points each. Mist ribbons are horizontal gradient fills, not particles — a single fillRect with a linear gradient, offset by a sine function of elapsed time and Harmonic amplitude. God rays are drawn as a clipped radial fill behind the ridge stack, masked with the composite ridge silhouette cached to an offscreen canvas each time the noise seed advances (every 30 frames). The offscreen ridge cache is the performance key: ridges re-render every half-second, not every frame. The sky gradient is a single radial gradient redrawn each frame with two colour stops that shift by amplitude. Bokeh motes are 12–18 large (radius 40–90px) semi-transparent circles in sc
proposals.humanTrace: The declared light source at (62%, 8%) is the human decision that conducts every downstream mark. The 35° shimmer angle, the god-ray origins, the text-shadow offset, the flare entry point — all derive from that one choice, made once, visible everywhere. The ridge noise seeds are fixed per visualizer instance: this scene has a specific mountain, not a random one. The biological-frequency bokeh oscillation (0.3–1.8Hz) is a replication of physical light behaviour, not a composed animation — the human trace is in the decision to simulate rather than invent. The lyric reveal timing — 18 frames, 4px drift, spring damping — is a performance decision: it is the speed at which a breath opens a word.
proposals.risk: Cinzel in a scene this atmospheric risks feeling ecclesiastical-ornate rather than still and reverential — it is a display face that carries weight, and in a moment of genuine quietude it must earn its scale. The risk is worth it because this lyric — 'Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side' — is not a quiet lyric dressed in quiet clothes; it is a vast claim stated with restraint, and Cinzel at 52px tracked wide is restraint with scale. The deeper risk is that seven depth planes plus god rays plus mist ribbons plus wisps plus optical pass is too many simultaneous moves for an integrated-GPU laptop. The mitigation is the offscreen ridge cache and the strict avoidance of particle systems — every element is a gradient or a fill, not a loop of individual objects. If the frame budget is threatened, the wisps are the first element to drop; the ridges and the lyric band are the irreducible cor

proposals.title: Seven Planes, One Breath
proposals.idea: Seven gradient strata, each a discrete luminance step, prove that atmosphere is already a grid — the lyric appears where the mist opens, not where the designer placed it.
proposals.geometry: Seven horizontal depth planes, each a full-bleed gradient band: #0E1726 at base, stepping through #28415C × 3 mid-registers, cresting to #7C98B3 at the upper ridges, with #F5D39E reserved exclusively for the summit sunbeam corona and lyric-band ambient lift. Planes are separated by a fixed 1/14th of frame height — no overlap, no blending between planes except via the atmospheric haze pass, which is a single low-opacity overlay gaussian, not per-plane blending. The lyric band occupies the fourth plane from top: structurally mid-atmosphere, never sky, never earth. God rays are radial gradients anchored at one fixed summit point, upper-right at the golden-ratio intersection (61.8% from left, 23.6% from top) — they do not animate their origin, only their opacity.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif, sentence case, no bold. Single lyric line centred on the fourth depth plane. Size: 4.2vw at 1080p, 4.0vw at 4K — optically equivalent at forty metres. Tracking: 0.08em. No drop shadow; instead, the text-safe dimming band is a full-width rectangle spanning planes three through five, filled #0E1726 at 52% opacity with a 40px vertical gaussian feather top and bottom — it belongs to the scene, not pasted over it. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in at 180ms ease-out, previous words hold at full opacity, no movement of any word after it lands. Line transition: outgoing line fades to zero at 320ms, incoming line holds dark for 400ms before first word begins — this pause is the editorial act, not a gap. Scripture attribution: Cinzel, 1.4vw, tracked 0.22em, uppercase, centred, separated from lyric by exactly one cap-height of vertical space, appears only after the full line is co
proposals.imageLogic: No concept plate. The entire scene is procedural Canvas 2D. Seven fillRect gradient bands are the ridges. The atmospheric haze is a single ctx.filter gaussian redrawn each frame at low cost. Bokeh motes: no more than eighteen circles, radii 6–22px, positioned at frame init using a seeded PRNG keyed to this visualizer's id (5), fixed XY for the session, opacity modulated by vocal amplitude only — they do not drift. God rays: six ctx.createLinearGradient strokes from summit anchor to frame edges, drawn once per frame as strokes with globalAlpha driven by swell envelope. Valley mist ribbons: three thin ellipses (height 4–7px, width 60–80% of frame) at the inter-plane boundaries of planes two, three, and four, opacity driven by harmonic envelope, maximum opacity 0.28 — they are suggestions, not shapes.
proposals.texture: Film grain is a single pre-generated 512×512 noise canvas, tiled, drawn at globalAlpha 0.045 — enough to prevent the gradients reading as digital flatness, not enough to be perceived as grain. No paper texture, no linen, no material metaphor beyond grain. The material weave for this lens is luminance discipline: the only 'texture' is the hard edge where one depth plane ends and the next begins, held precisely, never softened except by the atmospheric overlay. That edge is the tactile trace.
proposals.motion: Frame order is strict. 1. Depth planes: static. 2. Atmospheric haze overlay: breathes at 0.006–0.018 opacity, driven by a Perlin noise at 0.04 Hz — one full inhale-exhale every 25 seconds. This is the scene's only autonomous motion. 3. Valley mist ribbons: harmonic amplitude smoothed with a 1.2s attack, 3.0s release — they thicken on chord swells, vanish on silence. 4. God ray opacity: swell envelope, 0.8s attack, 4.0s release, maximum globalAlpha 0.22. 5. Bokeh mote opacity: vocal envelope, 0.3s attack, 1.8s release, maximum 0.35. 6. Summit corona: a radial gradient at the god-ray anchor, radius driven by swell, range 80–160px, ease spring-damped k=0.12 damping=0.72. Nothing moves position. Nothing strobes. The scene's motion budget is atmospheric opacity only.
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps requestAnimationFrame loop. Seven gradient planes rendered as fillRect with ctx.createLinearGradient, colours drawn from the four-colour palette only. Perlin noise computed via a 256-entry permutation table, evaluated once per frame for the haze breath and once per mote for flicker — no external library. All envelopes are first-order low-pass filters (coefficient computed from attack/release ms at frame rate). The 512×512 grain canvas is generated once at load with Math.random seeded to visualizer id, drawn via drawImage each frame. Lyric engine uses the kit's existing word-by-word reveal; this direction specifies timing constants only. Total draw calls per frame: under 40. No compositing beyond globalAlpha and one ctx.filter gaussian.
proposals.humanTrace: The seven luminance steps are not computed from a perceptual ramp — they are hand-declared values, each approved individually: the distance between plane two and plane three is wider than between five and six because the lower valleys hold more dark. That editorial decision, made once, propagates through every frame. The grain canvas is the only other trace: it was seeded to this visualizer's id, which means its specific noise is unrepeatable across the 72-piece collection — each piece has its own silence.
proposals.risk: A scene this reduced risks reading as unfinished to a congregation expecting scenic grandeur. Seven flat bands and a handful of motes is not a mountain landscape — it is the idea of one, edited to its load-bearing elements. The risk is worth it because legibility is the only non-negotiable, and every element removed from the scene is attention returned to the lyric. If the congregation sees the mountains, we failed; if they feel the altitude and read the words, we succeeded.

arguesWith.why: The Dramatist will add volumetric cloud layers, multiple god-ray origins, animated ridge parallax, and a bloom pass because the scene 'earns' it — seven ridges, summit sunbeams, drifting fog is a brief that invites accumulation. I hold that accumulation is not the same as atmosphere. The brief says the scene breathes with the singer's voice; a scene with twelve moving layers breathes with itself.

disputes.objection: Seven fillRect gradient bands are not seven ridges — they are seven shelves, and a shelf does not resolve into atmosphere because it has no silhouette to earn its recession. The hard inter-plane edge declared as the sole tactile trace is a renunciation of compositional consequence, not an exercise of it: when the edge carries no curvature, no pressure, no response to the light source, it cannot hold the eye at forty metres because there is nothing for the eye to land on — the rest is declared by fiat, not demonstrated by form. A structure that withholds every mark of making in the name of discipline has confused austerity with resolution, and those are not the same thing.
disputes.concession: The 400ms silence before the first incoming word begins is a genuinely earned pause — that is pacing as editorial act, and it is the one moment in this proposal where restraint produces consequence rather than merely removing content.

disputes.objection: Seven gradient bands separated by a fixed 1/14th and held precisely — that's not atmosphere, that's a diagram of atmosphere, and the distinction matters because a diagram refuses the body. The 'hard edge where one depth plane ends' called a tactile trace is the tell: no ink bleeds at a hard edge, no hand pressed anything there, the edge is just a number that was never risked. Holding grain to 0.045 so it doesn't 'read as grain' is the same move — removing evidence until nothing is left to argue with, which is exactly what I mean when I say the Minimalist edits until the work can't be challenged.
disputes.concession: The pause of 400ms before the first incoming word begins is a genuine editorial act — silence as punctuation, not as loading gap, and I'd steal it.

disputes.objection: The seven gradient bands are declared as 'depth planes' but they are not — they are luminance zones with no spatial logic binding them: there is no rule that makes plane four the lyric home except the designer's preference, and calling that 'where the mist opens' is a post-hoc story dressed as system logic. The bokeh motes fixed at session-init with opacity modulated by vocal amplitude are the clearest symptom: position and behavior are decoupled, which means the motes are decorative counters floating in a scene they do not belong to, not outputs of a coherent spatial model. When I ask 'what is the rule and what does it do when the input changes,' the answer here is: the positions never chan
disputes.concession: The 1.2s attack and 3.0s release asymmetry on the valley mist ribbons is a genuine system decision — the longer release correctly models how atmospheric haze dissipates more slowly than it thickens, and that is physically-plausible behavior, not an aesthetic guess.

disputes.objection: The seven luminance steps are declared as editorial acts, but the proposal never asks where those specific blue-slate values come from — they arrive as palette constants without a sourced geography, and calling the hard inter-plane edge a 'tactile trace' is the oldest minimalist sleight of hand: restraint performed as universality, specificity quietly evacuated. When The Minimalist says the lyric appears 'where the mist opens, not where the designer placed it,' that is exactly the move I distrust — it hides the designer's choice inside a claim of natural inevitability, which is how borrowed atmospheres get laundered into neutral ones. There is no mountain here; there is a gradient that asks
disputes.concession: The grain canvas seeded to each visualizer's id — unrepeatable across the 72-piece collection — is a genuine provenance decision: that specific noise belongs to this specific piece, and I wish more of the proposal held that same commitment.

disputes.objection: The pause before the first word — declared as 'the editorial act' — is not an act, it is an absence that has been mistaken for intention: four hundred milliseconds of black holding where the congregation expected light is not dramatic breath, it is the curtain stuck. The valley mist at maximum opacity 0.28 and the bokeh motes forbidden to drift are not restraint, they are a refusal to commit to what the scene feels like — the mountain is already atmospheric, yes, but atmosphere without a declared emotional temperature is weather, not drama. When the dimming band is described as belonging to the scene rather than pasted over it, I agree with the ambition, but belonging requires a relationship
disputes.concession: The seven hand-declared luminance steps — specifically the widened gap between planes two and three to hold the darker valley — is the most honest human editorial decision in this entire suite, and I would steal it without apology.

disputes.objection: The text-shadow keyed to the light-source angle, the anamorphic flare that fires on a Swell threshold, the atmospheric haze in screen blend, the radial bloom pulsing with Swell, the god-ray opacity range of 0–38% — each of these is defensible alone; together they are a room where every surface is speaking at once and none of them can hear the mountain. The declared light source is a real constraint, but a constraint that authorizes this many simultaneous effects is not editing, it is permission. The question I keep asking is: which of these elements could be removed without losing the meaning — and the answer is most of them, which means most of them are decoration dressed as structure.
disputes.concession: The single polar-coordinate light source declared before any draw call, from which every shimmer vector and god-ray origin derives, is exactly the kind of one traceable rule I would defend — the problem is not the rule, it is how many marks it was allowed to authorize.

synthesis.ariaSummary:
I took the Baroque Dramatist as lead for this one, with the Radical Minimalist as the necessary counterpoint and the Classical Mind cutting where the Dramatist accumulated past the brief's own instruction.

The Dramatist's core argument held: this scene has seven ridges, a declared summit light, valley fog, and alpine sunbeams — that is not a brief for reduction, it is a brief for atmosphere earned by structure. The single light source at (62%, 8%), declared before any draw call, conducting every god-ray origin, every mist-ribbon highlight, and every text-shadow offset, is the one rule that keeps all that atmosphere from becoming decoration. I took that rule seriously and let it govern everything downstream.

The team disagreed loudest on the lyric face and on how much the optical pass should do. The Minimalist argued — and I heard it — that a scene with twelve simultaneous moves breathes with itself, not with the singer. The Classical Mind agreed enough to make three cuts: display weight off the Cinzel, the flare reduced to a single non-repeating event, and the per-ridge noise advance removed from the per-frame loop. What survived is still atmospheric, still dramatic, still specific — but it no longer performs its own complexity at the congregation.

The one thing from the Minimalist that I kept without modification is the 400ms silence before the first word of an incoming line. Every other direction in the room treats that gap as a transition to minimize. The Minimalist named it correctly: it is punctuation, and punctuation is not a gap.

quotes.line: If the congregation sees the mountains, we failed; if they feel the altitude and read the words, we succeeded.
The declared light source at (62%, 8%) is the human decision that conducts every downstream mark.
